question.text: The DD must contain a statement that:

answer.text: SEBI has neither approved nor disapproved the document or certified its accuracy

explanation.text: The Logic: Standard disclaimer: SEBI has neither approved nor disapproved, and has not certified the content. The Trap: SEBI never approves DDs; no guarantees are permitted. Cross-Exam Context: Mirrors the MF offer document disclaimer in V-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Read this disclaimer aloud to clients at onboarding — it frames reasonable expectations.
